test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some rabbits are white.

Some rabbits are brown.

All white are yellow.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some brown are yellow.

II. Some rabbits are yellow.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0858d0802992d2547854f4d3c165d2693d24213dba5d854df0d94130fce1929.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some brown are yellow: **False **(Because there is no direct relationship given between Brown and Yellow).

II. Some rabbits are yellow: **True **(Because some white are Rabbits and all whites are yellow).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion II follows"**.
